<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[114.0,102.4,505.3,118.6] | Type:text -->
Namdini 黄金项目位于加纳共和国上东部省，博尔加坦加(Bolgatanga)区域中

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[90.0,122.3,336.2,138.5] | Type:text -->
心东南约50km，靠近布基纳法索的南部边界。

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[114.0,142.4,505.3,158.5] | Type:text -->
Talensi, where the project area is located, is one of the thirteen cities and regions in

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[90.0,162.4,505.2,178.6] | Type:text -->
the Upper Eastern Province of Ghana. It borders on Bolgatanga City in the north, the

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[90.0,182.3,505.2,198.5] | Type:text -->
west and east (both in the northern region) of Mamprusi District in the south, and

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[90.0,202.4,505.2,218.5] | Type:text -->
Kassena-Nankana District in the west, and it connects with Bawku West and Nabdam

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[90.0,222.4,180.6,238.6] | Type:text -->
District in the east.

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[114.0,242.3,505.2,258.5] | Type:text -->
项目区位于Talensi ，该地区是加纳上东部省的十三个市和地区之一，北部

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[90.0,262.4,505.2,278.5] | Type:text -->
与Bolgatanga 市接壤，南部与Mamprusi 区的西部和东部(均在北部地区)接壤，

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[90.0,282.4,439.1,298.6] | Type:text -->
西部与Kassena-Nankana 区接壤，东至Bawku West 和Nabdam 区。

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[114.0,302.3,505.3,318.5] | Type:text -->
The terrain in the project area is mostly flat with gently rolling topography that

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[90.0,322.4,505.2,338.5] | Type:text -->
keeps rising to the south, and the area is covered by sediments. The altitude varies from

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[90.0,342.4,505.3,358.6] | Type:text -->
180m to 200m, with an average of about 190m. The landform is dominated by

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[90.0,362.3,505.2,378.5] | Type:text -->
savannahs that is characterized by sparsely clustered drought-resistant trees, shrubs and

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[90.0,382.4,505.3,398.5] | Type:text -->
grasses. In the long dry season, there are seasonal jungle fires burning or strong

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[90.0,402.4,131.6,418.6] | Type:text -->
sunlight.

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[114.0,424.6,505.3,436.6] | Type:text -->
项目区域内的地形地势多为平坦，地形起伏平缓，一直上升到南部，区内被

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[90.0,442.4,505.3,458.5] | Type:text -->
沉积物覆盖。海拔从180m～200 m 不等，平均海拔约为190m。地貌主要是稀树

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[90.0,464.6,505.3,476.6] | Type:text -->
草原，其特征是散布着稀疏聚集的抗旱树木、灌木和草。在漫长的干旱季，季节

<!-- Page:4 | BBox:[90.0,484.6,282.0,496.6] | Type:text -->
性地有丛林大火燃烧或被太阳暴晒。

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[114.0,102.9,505.2,119.0] | Type:text -->
2) Technical requirements for online chromatographic monitoring of transformer

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,127.4,102.7,143.5] | Type:text -->
oil

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[114.0,151.7,295.0,167.9] | Type:text -->
2) 变压器油色谱在线监测技术要求

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[114.0,176.2,505.2,192.4] | Type:text -->
A. The system can online monitor the content and growth rate of dissolved gases

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,200.7,508.2,216.8] | Type:text -->
in transformer oil, including hydrogen, methane, carbon monoxide, acetylene, ethylene,

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,225.2,310.2,241.3] | Type:text -->
ethane, carbon dioxide and total hydrocarbon.

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[114.0,249.5,505.2,265.7] | Type:text -->
A. 系统可在线监测变压器油中溶解气体，包括氢气、甲烷、一氧化碳、乙

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,276.2,366.0,288.2] | Type:text -->
炔、乙烯、乙烷、二氧化碳、总烃的含量及增长率。

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[114.0,298.5,505.3,314.6] | Type:text -->
B. The monitoring system includes online monitoring of dissolved gas content in

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,323.0,505.2,339.1] | Type:text -->
oil and chromatographic analysis and diagnosis. It can automatically realize functions

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,347.3,505.2,363.5] | Type:text -->
such as data acquisition, baseline correction, three-ratio analysis, calculation of relative

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,371.8,505.2,388.0] | Type:text -->
and absolute gas production rates, trend chart analysis, chromatogram analysis and

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,396.3,473.2,412.4] | Type:text -->
fault diagnosis, and enable query of historical data and original chromatograms.

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[114.0,420.8,505.3,436.9] | Type:text -->
B. 监测系统包括在线监测油中溶解气体含量和色谱分析诊断两部分，能自

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,447.4,510.0,459.4] | Type:text -->
动实现数据采集、基线修正、三比值分析、相对产气速率和绝对产气速率计算、

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,471.8,505.3,483.8] | Type:text -->
趋势图分析、色谱谱图分析及故障诊断等功能，能够对历史数据和原始谱图进行

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,496.3,126.0,508.3] | Type:text -->
查询。

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[114.0,518.6,505.3,534.7] | Type:text -->
C. The alarm signal can be transmitted remotely. The device has an Ethernet port

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,542.9,505.2,559.1] | Type:text -->
and an RS485 communication port, which meets the IEC-61850 protocol. The

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,567.4,505.2,583.6] | Type:text -->
operation condition and alarm signal of the device shall be able to be connected to the

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,591.9,505.2,608.0] | Type:text -->
integrated automation system of the substation, and cooperate with the integrated

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,616.4,405.2,632.5] | Type:text -->
automation system to complete signal acquisition and integration.

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[114.0,640.7,505.3,656.9] | Type:text -->
C. 报警信号可远传，装置具有以太网口和RS485 通讯口，满足IEC-61850

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,667.4,505.3,679.4] | Type:text -->
协议，装置运行情况及报警信号应能接入变电站综自系统，并配合综自系统完成

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,691.9,210.0,703.9] | Type:text -->
信号采集及集成工作。

D. Alarm function: hydrogen concentration, acetylene concentration, total

<!-- Page:24 | BBox:[90.0,738.5,328.6,754.7] | Type:text -->
hydrocarbon concentration, etc. can be set at will.
